instruction: Candid documentary photograph from a wide, high angle in a motion capture lab with a red carpet and dark red partition walls. In the center, the man in the black t-shirt and blue shorts (R1), wearing a black skullcap, stands directly behind the woman in the white t-shirt with a red pattern and blue jeans (R2), embracing her in a warm back hug. She stands facing forward, holding his hands wrapped around her chest. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead lights.
